tasks.description: Implement and test core backend APIs for haiku submission, voting, and leaderboard retrieval.
tasks.result_summary:
Implemented a complete core backend for Haiku Battle League with full integration test coverage:

### Key Features
- **Endpoints**  
  • `POST /api/auth/register` & `login`  
  • `POST /api/haiku` (user‑auth required)  
  • `GET /api/haiku/:id` & `random`  
  • `GET /api/battle/pair` & `POST /api/battle` (auth required)  
  • `GET /api/leaderboard` (period support)  
  • `GET /api/auth/me` and `GET /api/points`
